root_causes.name: kafka_consumer_lag
root_causes.summary: Kafka consumer lag on payments-ledger after a deploy or nightly batch
root_causes.detail: A payments-ledger deploy or the nightly settlement batch pushed far more events through the payments topic than the consumer group could drain. Lag crossed the alerting threshold and checkout requests that wait on ledger confirmation timed out.

root_causes.name: redis_failover_flap
root_causes.summary: Redis sentinel failover flap caused connection churn
root_causes.detail: A redis-cache sentinel failover flapped between replicas. Clients reconnected repeatedly, so connection setup cost dominated latency and cache hit rate collapsed.

root_causes.name: tls_cert_expiry
root_causes.summary: Expired internal TLS certificate on auth-service
root_causes.detail: The internal TLS certificate used between the edge and auth-service expired. Handshakes failed and token validation returned 5xx for a share of requests.

root_causes.name: deploy_regression_latency
root_causes.summary: payments-ledger v1.8.3 added a synchronous ledger write on the checkout path
root_causes.detail: payments-ledger v1.8.3 introduced a synchronous write to the ledger audit table inside the checkout request path. The write serialised behind a hot row lock and inflated p99 latency without any infrastructure saturation.

root_causes.name: connection_pool_exhaustion
root_causes.summary: checkout-api database connection pool exhausted under burst traffic
root_causes.detail: A traffic burst plus slow ledger calls held every connection in the checkout-api pool. New requests queued for a connection instead of failing fast.

root_causes.name: webhook_retry_storm
root_causes.summary: webhook-dispatcher retry storm amplified downstream load
root_causes.detail: webhook-dispatcher retried failed deliveries immediately and without a cap, multiplying load on payments-ledger until the ledger degraded for real traffic.

root_causes.name: fraud_scorer_model_timeout
root_causes.summary: fraud-scorer model inference exceeded its timeout budget
root_causes.detail: A newly promoted fraud model exceeded the inference timeout budget. Requests fell back to the slow rule engine, which pushed checkout p99 over SLO.

root_causes.name: cache_stampede
root_causes.summary: Redis cache stampede after bulk key eviction
root_causes.detail: A memory-pressure eviction dropped a hot key set at once. Every in-flight request rebuilt the same entries concurrently, saturating payments-ledger.

root_causes.name: signing_key_rotation_without_overlap
root_causes.summary: Webhook signing key rotated with no dual-key overlap window
root_causes.detail: The webhook signing key was rotated and the previous key retired immediately. Deliveries queued before the rotation were signed with the retired key, so every retry failed signature verification and the delivery queue backed up.
